title: 第十三章 差距第十四章 闷声发大财
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
地精佛德的身体前倾，从木椅上跳了下来。
它依旧努力保持着那种程式化的高傲姿态——挺起胸膛，微微扬起下巴。
但姿态里已经没有了刻意的威慑，反而透着几分真实的审视。
它说话的语气，也变得平淡了一些：“小子，你让佛德大爷有点意外。”
这只地精顿了顿，黄色的眼珠微微转动，从上到下打量着莫宁。
“你一点不像那些差劲的家伙。”
似乎是刚才的印象太过深刻，佛德甚至重复了一遍，像是在确认自己的判断：
“完全不像。”
所谓的“差劲的家伙”，无疑就是指那些在佛德的威慑下屁滚尿流的新人。
而它了解每位新人的基本信息。
所以它知道，莫宁的精神天赋非常平庸。
正因为如此，它才如此惊讶。
一个天赋垫底的新人，面对它的威慑，居然没有逃跑，没有尖叫，没有失态。
他甚至还礼貌地问候了一句“佛德先生，幸会”。
这让地精非常意外。
佛德侧过身，伸出一只绿色的手指，指了指旁边的藤蔓拱门。
“进去吧。”
莫宁没有急着迈步。
他站在原地，对着这只地精微微一笑。
笑容不卑不亢，恰到好处，带着一丝不太明显的恭维：“佛德先生，您出现在这里，背后一定有一个传奇性的故事。”

他顿了顿，让每一个字都落得更清晰：“希望有一天，可以坐下来与您好好聊一聊，听一听您的故事。”
这句话里的“传奇性”，是一种不动声色的抬举。
而“聊一聊”，则传递了一重更隐晦的含义——我一直用平视的态度，看待地精这个种族。
对地精来说，这是一种很罕见的态度。
由于容貌、形象、生活习惯的缘故，人类对地精的歧视已经深入骨髓。
举一个最简单的例子：在各个人类王国，“你脏得像一只地精”是一句非常常见的骂人话。
地精，就是肮脏的代名词。
这已经成为了思想钢印。
莫宁丝毫不怀疑，佛德作为异类生活在学院里，平时没有少遭到明里暗里的歧视。
那些人类学徒看它的眼神，那些从背后飘来的窃窃私语，那些刻意保持的距离——
它一定经历过太多。
莫宁觉得，向对方释放一些善意，未来说不定会有意外的收获。
反正又不用花黑塔点。
为什么不呢？
他再次微微颔首，然后步履平稳地转过身，走入了通往食堂的拱门。
但佛德注视着这道背影，神情发生了微妙的变化。
那双黄色的眼珠里，有什么东西在微微闪动。
毫无疑问。
content_en:
Goblin Ford leaned forward and jumped down from the wooden chair.
It still strives to maintain the stylized proud posture - puffing out its chest and slightly raising its chin.
But the gesture no longer contained deliberate intimidation, but instead revealed a bit of real scrutiny.
The tone of its words also became calmer: "Boy, you surprised Uncle Ford."
The goblin paused, his yellow eyes turning slightly, looking at Mourning from top to bottom.
"You're nothing like those bad guys."
It seemed that the impression just now was too deep, and Ford even repeated it, as if to confirm his judgment:
"Not at all like that."
The so-called "bad guys" undoubtedly refer to the newcomers who fell into disrepair under Ford's intimidation.
And it knows basic information about each new person.
So it knows that Mourning's mental talent is very mediocre.
That's why it's so surprising.
A newcomer with the lowest talent actually didn't run away, scream, or lose his composure when faced with its intimidation.
He even greeted politely, "Nice to meet you, Mr. Ford."
This surprised the goblin.
Ford turned sideways, stretched out a green finger, and pointed at the vine arch next to him.
"Go in."
Mourning didn't move in a hurry.
He stood there and smiled at the goblin.
The smile was neither condescending nor arrogant, just right, with a hint of less obvious compliment: "Mr. Ford, there must be a legendary story behind your appearance here."
He paused to make every word clearer: "I hope that one day, I can sit down and have a good chat with you and listen to your story."
The "legendary" in this sentence is a kind of quiet praise.
"Have a chat" conveys a more obscure meaning - I have always viewed the goblins as a race with a level head.
This is a very rare attitude for goblins.
Due to their appearance, image, and living habits, humans' discrimination against goblins has been deeply rooted in their bones.
To give the simplest example: "You are as dirty as a goblin" is a very common curse word in various human kingdoms.
Goblins are synonymous with filth.
This has become an ideological stamp.
Mourning had no doubt that Ford, as an alien living in the academy, was often subjected to overt or covert discrimination.
The way the human apprentices looked at it, the whispers coming from behind, the distance they deliberately kept—
It must have been through a lot.
Mourning felt that by showing some goodwill to the other party, there might be unexpected gains in the future.
There’s no need to spend black tower points anyway.
why not?
He nodded slightly again, then turned around smoothly and walked into the archway leading to the cafeteria.
But as Ford stared at the back, his expression changed subtly.
There was something flickering in those yellow eyes.
There is no doubt about it.
